top_signals.title: Inflation voters’ top concern as Iran war bites
top_signals.summary: A vicious bout of inflation set off by the US’s war in Iran is now British voters’ top concern, according a closely follwed poll that laid bare the scale of economic pessimism that continues to stalk the UK. Nearly four in 10 (37 per cent) UK adults listed price rises as a big issue facing [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: From Squeezes to Meltdown, a Week of Mayhem Rocks Metals Markets
top_signals.summary: As the copper industry gathered in Shanghai last week, Grace Li was struck by the overwhelmingly bearish mood over the outlook for demand. She agreed with the pessimism. In fact, she came close to pulling out her phone on the spot to put on a short position after her Monday conversations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
